title: Nine Letters of Trust
subtitle: 品牌与商标 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品牌与商标（社会服务与人际沟通·商业与消费）
meta: 主题语境：品牌与商标（社会服务与人际沟通·商业与消费）　|　核心词汇：brand　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 brand 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my mother was sent to name ① a brand she could not trust, and she said the trusting was the whole of the lesson. The ② brand, meaning the mark and not the goods, was nine letters long and was printed by whoever came last; a brand, she said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ brand in that ledger had the same date, and the ④ brand at the front, meaning the one the shop kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked properly. A brand, my grandmother said, is nine parts promise and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the promise is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ brand was the whole of the shop, meaning the name it carried and not the mark. The ⑥ brand, meaning the name and not any of that, is the only thing in a market that everybody asks for and nobody questions; a brand, he said, is either something you name or the only word that means both a mark and a name. She said the name is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ brand had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the promise. The ⑧ brand of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine letters and eleven years of naming; a brand, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ brand I remember is the one at the front, which was registered in 1979 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ brand, my grandmother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being trusted; every brand, she said, is a name that has agreed to look like a mark. She said the name was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 品牌（指那个标记本身，与货物相对）
C. 固定搭配：name a brand 说出一个品牌的名字
D. n. 品牌（指账簿上每一个）
E. n. 品牌（指前面那一个）
F. n. 品牌信誉（抽象：与那个标记相对）
G. n. 那个名字、那份信誉（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a brand she could not trust
The brand, meaning the mark and not the goods
brand was the whole of the shop
the brand had become a number in a report
The brand of the whole thing
A brand, my grandmother said in 1984

answers.why: name a brand 意为“说出一个品牌的名字”，1957 年母亲被派去说出一个她信不过的品牌。
brand 意为“品牌”，指那个标记本身而不是货物，共九个字母，由最后走的人印上去。
brand 指账簿上每一个品牌，每一个都是同一个日期。
brand 指前面那一个（店铺留的那一个），是唯一有人认真核对过的。
brand 意为“品牌信誉”，与那个标记相对，父亲说 brand 就是那家店的全部。
brand 为抽象用法，指那个名字、那份信誉本身，是市场上人人都点名要、却没人质疑的东西。
brand 意为“品牌、商标”，到 1973 年这个 brand 成了报告里的一个数字。
brand 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个字母和十一年的命名。
brand 意为“品牌”，我记得的是前面那一个，1979 年注册，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
brand 为抽象总称，祖母说品牌是唯一会因为被人信任而变好的东西。
